name: herdr-vscode-sync
description: Follow the focused Herdr workspace in a VS Code window.

commands.title: Herdr VS Code Sync: follow now

herdrVscodeSync.currentFile.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `current.json` the Herdr plugin writes. When empty, the extension auto-discovers it under the Herdr data directory (`~/.config/herdr` / `~/.local/state/herdr` on Linux/Mac).
